generationInputs.prompt: A vintage-style poster with a limited red-toned palette on a cream background depicts a luminous pink donut, an eggplant, and a banana with syringes on a stormy night with lightning and abundant fog. The central element is a luminous pink donut, seemingly weightless, from which two female legs clad in black fishnet stockings and black high-heeled shoes emerge. Two hands also extend from the donut, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid and the other holding a glass pipe. Pink liquid and white spilled milk drip from the donut's base, which is adorned with numerous diamonds and pink sprinkles, creating a holographic effect on the icing. Next to the donut, an eggplant holds a syringe, and a banana also holds a glowing syringe. Viscous, shimmering white liquid surrounds the subjects. The entire scene is set against a dark, stormy night with abundant fog and dramatic lightning strikes. The poster features a large, bold headline arching across the top in all caps, stating "YO PAS CL SLM FF", and a tagline below it that reads "TU VRGN SLM ACT", both in a mid-century serif font. A few mid-century sparkle or starburst icons are scattered around the headline.
